brand.name: Northlight Joinery
brand.tagline: Built-in shelving and kitchens, made to measure
brand.summary: A small joinery workshop. We measure in person, draw every piece before we cut, and fit it ourselves, usually within six weeks of sign-off.

items.title: Alcove shelving
items.text: Solid oak or painted birch ply, scribed to uneven walls and fixed without visible brackets.

items.title: Fitted kitchens
items.text: Carcasses built in the workshop, doors in your choice of timber or paint finish.

items.title: Repairs and refits
items.text: New doors, worktops or drawers for an existing kitchen, matched to what is already there.

faqs.q: Do you charge for a site visit?
faqs.a: No. We visit, measure and send a written quote within a week.
